description: This Java class defines a mock implementation of a sensor device (MockIASSensor) for testing or simulation purposes within a Zigbee-based IoT framework. It extends MockZigbeeDevice and implements MockSensor, encapsulating multiple clusters such as zone, polling, temperature measurement, and power configuration, and provides various methods to manipulate and retrieve sensor states.

classes.name: MockIASSensor
classes.description: A mock sensor device class simulating an IASSensor with multiple associated clusters for testing Zigbee device interactions.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Returns whether the zone cluster reports a low battery condition.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Sets the battery voltage in the zone cluster.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the current battery voltage from the zone cluster.

methods.name: setFaulted
methods.description: Sets the faulted state in the zone cluster.

methods.name: isFaulted
methods.description: Checks if the zone cluster indicates a fault.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Checks if the zone cluster indicates tampering.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered status on the zone cluster.

methods.name: setMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Sets the measured temperature in the temperature measurement cluster.

methods.name: getMeasuredTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the measured temperature from the temperature measurement cluster.

methods.name: isTroubled
methods.description: Checks if the zone cluster indicates a trouble condition.

methods.name: setTroubled
methods.description: Sets the troubled state in the zone cluster.

methods.name: sendCheckIn
methods.description: Triggers a check-in message via the poll control cluster.

methods.name: sendComcastCheckIn
methods.description: Sends a detailed Comcast check-in message with various parameters via the poll control cluster.
